text_block_list.text:
Preparing for the Sprinters Stakes.
We move forward with analyzing the rivals.
Both Believe and Calstone Light O are tough opponents, but the one to watch out for the most is...
choice_data_list: (It really has to be Believe, right?)

text_block_list.text:
Because Calstone Light O's running style is so extreme,
she often suffers heavy losses. For that reason...

Presently, Believe is the strongest sprinter.
That was the general consensus, and my view was no different.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, please behold.
That running style of Believe-san's.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Solid running that never falters, no matter the circumstances...
It is truly like an impregnable fortress.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Biko-san,
thank you for running alongside me. Thanks to you...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can run
with an even stronger determination now.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Believe-senpai, you should have more confidence!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It definitely dwells within Believe-senpai too.
Yes, that special something only heroes possess—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: An unbreakable heart, without fail!
The hero-loving Umamusume, Biko Pegasus, also acknowledged that strength of heart.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
An unbreakable spirit... That is truly so accurate.
No matter how hard you challenge Believe-san,
she doesn't flinch in the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: She's a formidable opponent who never wears down.

At first glance, Believe seems plain, but deep down,
the blood of an indomitable hero unquestionably flows through her veins.

And on the day of the race.
There was only one strategy
to defeat such an indomitable opponent.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My King,
the time for our decisive battle has finally come."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Please give me tactical instructions.
choice_data_list: Go from behind! That's my only instruction.
Go from behind! That's my only instruction.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Chaser strategy... Is that all?
With just that, you intend to beat Believe-san...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take the win without getting stuck in a duel if possible!
Yeah, let's try to win without getting caught in a battle!

text_block_list.text:
"If it turns into a grueling battle of attrition, there's no chance of winning.
In that case, the only option here is to run the kind of race I excel at."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then all that's left is to bet everything—on a single decisive strike.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us dedicate ourselves to our own way of fighting,
and carve open a new path forward!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: There you are, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I didn't think you'd enter
this Sprinters Stakes, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"As the saying goes, 'A wise man adapts to the times.'
This challenge may seem reckless, but it is the will of our King."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If that is so—then it must lie ahead!
The path leading toward hope.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What the King believes in, I believe in.
Where the King points, I shall march.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The King alone! Only the King gives
meaning to my battle and my running!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I am well aware of their strength.
However—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, too, shall not take a single step back!
In answer to the King's bold decision, I plant our battle banner upon this land!
"Durandal accepted my decision without a shred of hesitation."

Reading the tide of battle, she makes a lightning-fast entry.
The course of the race now rests upon Durandal's "Holy Sword."
